title: LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.19530v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents' returns. Yet a single run's return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model's training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. translated_title: LLM交易智能体赚取的是贝塔而非阿尔法：一个无前瞻偏差的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）交易智能体如今已为用户实际交易股票，而基准测试则根据智能体的收益对模型进行排名。然而，单次运行的收益几乎无法体现交易技能。在我们的研究中，同一模型仅随机种子不同的两次运行，平均结果相差5.2个点，因此要从运气中辨别真实技能，需要在多个市场、模型和种子上进行大量回测。然而，实盘竞技场每天只交易一次，而回测要么使用模型训练截止日期之后的几个月数据，要么在模型可能记忆过的年份上运行，且通常按日历日期将新闻与价格匹配。本文提出了rta-bench-1，这是一个覆盖三个美国市场行情（上涨、熊市和崩盘）的回测基准。它只在每条新闻发布分钟之后才将其展示给智能体，以盲测和实名两种方式运行每个时期，并对每次运行进行前瞻偏差检查。它还将每次收益分解为因子暴露与阿尔法成分，并将每个决策与同一天的随机选择进行对比评分。
tldr: 本文提出无前瞻偏差的rta-bench-1回测基准，通过严格控制新闻发布时间、盲测运行并将收益分解为因子暴露与阿尔法，发现LLM交易智能体赚取的主要是市场贝塔收益而非真正的阿尔法，且单次运行收益受随机种子影响巨大。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces rta-bench-1, a look-ahead-free backtest benchmark across three US market regimes that reveals headlines only after publication, runs blind named periods, and decomposes returns into factor exposure and alpha, showing that LLM trading agents earn beta rather than alpha and that single-run returns are heavily influenced by random seeds.
